record.question: Which of the following becomes a part of the Consolidated Fund of India? 1. Capitation Tax 2. Taxes on railway fares and freight charges 3. Taxes on sale and purchase of newspapers and advertisements therein
record.explanation: Under the Constitution, capitation tax is a State levy (Article 276), so it does not form part of the Consolidated Fund of India. Taxes on railway fares and freight are assigned to the States under Article 269 and do not form part of the Consolidated Fund of India, and taxes on newspaper sales are State taxes. None of the statements is correct, so 'None of these' is selected.
